set.body: Triggered by the hash-pinned sub18 court: initial native matching yields 18 correspondences and bridge assimilation is accepted, but mandatory rematch aborts when a moved fixed-work anchor retains only 6 of 21 required reference samples. Test one factor only: make rematch support-aware while retaining the frozen initial matcher, projector, assimilator, topology floors, and budget2x plan. Predeclare deterministic support qualification and a minimum retained-anchor contract; never use the moving evaluation mask or labels. First prove synthetic identity and translation behavior plus JVM and Scala.js parity. Then rerun the unchanged sub18 court. Success means the complete round returns a typed result and records retained/dropped rematch anchors; it does not promote accuracy unless export is admitted, endpoint Jacobians are positive, and frozen fine refinement completes. If safe completion still fails, retain the failure and only then open a separate global-affine or bridge-boundary factor.
set.title: BasinBridge B6: support-aware real-data rematch
